name: Blackboard Learn
summary: An institutional learning management system for course delivery, assessment, grading, communication and learning administration. The product supports the Blackboard Learn Ultra experience and sits within Blackboard’s focused teaching and learning portfolio.

value: Blackboard Ally accessibility support is a related product, not assumed to be included in every licence
named integrations include Turnitin, VitalSource, Zoom and Microsoft Teams

value.notes: Not publicly listed; institutional quote required. Institutional quote; no public list price.

security.notes: additional cloud controls/certifications should be checked against the current Trust Center and product scope.

value.notes: Generative AI features are opt-in. Blackboard says client data is not used to (re)train the models; Microsoft commits to this contractually for Azure OpenAI.

accessibility.finding: Blackboard describes product-specific accessibility conformance reports, but the current Blackboard LMS report was not retrieved.
accessibility.caveat: Request the current, dated report for Blackboard LMS (Ultra).

security.finding: Blackboard states ISO 27001 and ISO 27701 certification (audited by A-LIGN) and annual SOC 2 Type II examinations for several products, including Blackboard LMS.
security.caveat: SOC 2 reports are requested through the account manager.

dataResidency.finding: Blackboard says many products are regionally hosted, but support, messaging and generative AI may be provided from outside the hosting location.
dataResidency.caveat: Confirm the Australian region and every exception in the contract.

ai.finding: Generative AI features are opt-in and run on Microsoft Azure OpenAI Service (and AWS Bedrock for Ally). Blackboard says client data is not used to retrain the models, and publishes a transparency note for each feature.
ai.caveat: Azure OpenAI runs on multiple global instances; ask where Australian prompts are processed.

procurementChecks: Obtain current product-specific accessibility conformance report and confirm version/module scope.
Request current SOC 2 Type II / ISO certificates and verify legal entity, service boundary, audit period and exceptions.
Confirm production, backup, disaster-recovery, logs, telemetry, support and AI processing locations in contract/DPA.

researchTasks: Commercial relationship set to none; confirm before publication (affiliate programs in docs/affiliates.md).
* trial: no public trial terms, so left out (not set to false): Institutional demonstration / procurement enquiry; public trial not identified.
* data residency: no committed region; confirm the tenant region in the contract.

value.freeTierNote: No permanent free institutional tier identified; institutional demonstration and procurement enquiry.
value.trialNote: Institutional demonstration / procurement enquiry; public trial not identified

value.evidence: Blackboard states WCAG 2.2 AA compliance at company level; request the current Blackboard Learn product-specific ACR/VPAT and version/scope before relying on this for procurement.

value.notes: Regional hosting options; exact location, transfer arrangements and subprocessors are contract-dependent. Use the hosting and data-transfer documentation and contract schedule to confirm the specific tenant region, cross-border transfers and subprocessors.
